groups.title: Cold Relief Soft Capsule
groups.efficacy: This medicine is used for runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing, sore throat, cough, phlegm, chills, fever, headache, joint pain and muscle pain in a cold.
groups.usage: For people aged 15 years and over and adults, 2 capsules per dose; for people over 7 years to under 15 years, 1 capsule per dose, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
groups.caution: Anyone who regularly drinks 3 or more glasses of alcohol a day should consult a doctor or pharmacist before taking this medicine or any other antipyretic analgesic. Before taking it, consult a doctor or pharmacist.

summaryTable.Use: Cold symptoms: runny nose, congestion, sore throat, cough, fever, aches
summaryTable.Check with a pharmacist: Age 7 years or under; regular alcohol use

groups.title: Antispasmodic Antacid Tablet
groups.efficacy: This medicine is used for stomach pain, abdominal pain, colic, excess stomach acid and heartburn.
groups.usage: For adults, 2 tablets 2 to 3 times a day; for people aged 8 to 14 years, 1 tablet 2 to 3 times a day, after or between meals. When taken 2 or more times a day, leave an interval of at least 4 hours.
groups.caution: Do not take if you are an infant or young child aged 7 years or under, or have galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or a related genetic problem. Before taking it, consult a doctor or pharmacist.

summaryTable.Use: Stomach and abdominal pain, colic, excess acid, heartburn
summaryTable.Check with a pharmacist: Age 7 years or under; galactose intolerance

groups.title: Anti-inflammatory Enzyme Enteric-coated Tablet

groups.caution: Do not take if you have galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or a genetic problem such as glucose-galactose malabsorption. Before taking it, consult a doctor or pharmacist.

summaryTable.Use: Inflammatory swelling after surgery or injury; milk stasis

groups.title: Ibuprofen Oral Syrup
groups.efficacy: This medicine is used for rheumatoid arthritis, juvenile rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis, and for related pain and fever.
groups.usage: For rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, soft tissue injury, non-articular rheumatic disease, acute gout or psoriatic arthritis, adults take 200 to 600 mg 3 to 4 times a day, up to a maximum of 3200 mg a day. For juvenile rheumatoid arthritis, take 30 to 40 mg per kg of body weight per dose, 3 to 4 times a day in divided doses. For mild to moderate pain or a cold, adults take 200 to 400 mg 3 to 4 times a day. Adjust appropriately according to age and symptoms. For children, refer to the approved information for those aged 11 to 14 years.
groups.caution: Anyone who regularly drinks 3 or more glasses of alcohol a day should consult a doctor or pharmacist before taking this medicine or any other antipyretic analgesic, as it may cause gastrointestinal bleeding. Before taking it, consult a doctor or pharmacist.

summaryTable.Use: Arthritis, pain and fever, gout, soft tissue injury
summaryTable.Check with a pharmacist: Maximum 3200 mg a day; gastrointestinal bleeding
